data.value: Amid accelerating global change, anticipating the future of maritime security and protecting vital corridors and supply chains is a strategic priority — reflecting the strategic role of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in strengthening the security of the seas and safeguarding critical infrastructure above the surface and in the depths.

data.name: Landing.Intro.Sub
data.value: The future of seabed security and supply chains in a changing global environment

data.name: Landing.Intro.Lead
data.value: The world is witnessing unprecedented shifts in maritime security. As threats to global supply chains escalate, seabed security is emerging as an urgent international priority — to reinforce the stability of the seas and safeguard the sustainability of the global economy.

data.name: Landing.Stats.Lead
data.value: A broad global presence bringing together countries, entities, speakers and experts on one platform to advance cooperation and innovation in maritime security and supply chains.

data.name: Landing.About.Title
data.value: A Saudi global platform for dialogue and cooperation on maritime security

data.name: Landing.About.Lead
data.value: The Saudi International Maritime Forum rises to the level of a global event that brings together leaders, decision-makers and officials to exchange experience and expertise and to build a shared global understanding of the future of maritime security amid accelerating geopolitical and technological shifts — reflecting the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's strategic role in anchoring the stability of the seas and supporting the sustainability of the global economy.

data.name: Landing.About.ImageAlt
data.value: The Saudi International Maritime Forum hall

data.name: Landing.Miles.Title
data.value: Defining moments in the evolution of the global maritime-security agenda

data.name: Landing.Miles.Desc
data.value: A look back at the forum's journey and the milestones that have shaped the global maritime-security agenda across its past editions.

data.name: Landing.Hero2.Lead
data.value: To strengthen an integrated maritime-security system that supports international efforts to protect the seabed and improve the efficiency of energy and trade supply chains — contributing to the stability of the global economy and aligning with the goals of Vision 2030.

data.name: Landing.Themes.Sub
data.value: To shape a comprehensive strategic vision addressing energy, trade and connectivity systems between the surface and the depths — through five key themes that form the pillars of maritime security and global economic stability.

data.name: Landing.Sessions.Desc
data.value: Three plenary sessions tracing the forum's core themes — from energy and logistics to the security of the digital deep.

data.name: Landing.Speakers.Lead
data.value: The forum brings together an elite group of Saudi and international leaders, decision-makers and experts — reflecting the Kingdom's leading role in shaping the direction of maritime security and strengthening international cooperation amid accelerating technological and strategic shifts.

data.value: The forum is backed by government bodies and national and international institutions whose expertise strengthens the Kingdom's presence within the global maritime-security system and affirms the importance of joint action to keep pace with rapid change in this vital sector.

data.value: From ancient heritage to future cities, discover the destinations that make a visit to the Kingdom unforgettable.

data.name: Visit.Visa.Sub
data.value: Entering Saudi Arabia is easier than ever — here is how to plan your travel and visa for the forum.

data.name: Visit.Visa.Body1
data.value: Getting an entry visa to Saudi Arabia is now easier! eVisas and visas on arrival are available for 66 nationalities, in addition to holders of a valid, previously used US, UK or Schengen visa. Residents of the GCC countries who work in qualifying professions can also apply for an eVisa through their portal.

data.name: Visit.Visa.Body2
data.value: The Saudi authorities have also announced that citizens of any country holding a US, UK or Schengen visa are eligible to apply for a tourist visa. These tourist visas allow Muslims from eligible countries to perform Umrah at any time outside the Hajj season. Muslims of any of the nationalities above may visit Makkah and Madinah on an eVisa. Non-Muslims cannot enter Makkah at any time during their visit to Saudi Arabia.
